name: Nzbget
description: NZBGet can run on almost any device - classic PC, NAS, media player, SAT-receiver, WLAN-router, etc. The download area provides precompiled binaries for Windows, macOS, Linux (compatible with many CPUs and platform variants), FreeBSD and Android. For other platforms the program can be compiled from sources.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Nzbget pass
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  nzbget:
    environment:
      NZBGET_PASS: ${SECRET_NZBGET_PASS}
      NZBGET_USER: nzbget
      PGID: "1000"
      PUID: "1000"
      TZ: Europe/London
    image: linuxserver/nzbget:26.1.20260522
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 6789
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Downloads
        target: /downloads
    container_name: nzbget
